summary: Add Cloudflare deployment for the Fractal UI Storybook with main and pull-request stages

schema.detail: No application schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No runtime admission or reconciliation rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds a separate, non-required Storybook deployment workflow and an Alchemy v2 stack with Cloudflare remote state. Main targets https://storybook.compounding.tech by default; same-repository pull requests use isolated pr-N stages that are destroyed on close. Existing required checks are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Static Storybook hosting is independent of the application and daemon.

manual.detail: An administrator must configure CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID for an existing Cloudflare account, authorize remote-state bootstrap and deployment, and configure the custom-domain zone or choose workers.dev. See docs/development.md#storybook-deployment.

recovery.detail: Redeploy the desired revision to main to restore Storybook content. Destroy an abandoned preview with pnpm --dir infra/storybook run destroy --stage pr-N using the same Cloudflare account and remote state.
